query:
SELECT created_at::text AS "created_at?"
        FROM twitch_streamers
        WHERE ($1 <> '' AND twitch_user_id = $1)
           OR ($2 <> '' AND LOWER(twitch_login) = $2)
        ORDER BY
            CASE WHEN $1 <> '' AND twitch_user_id = $1 THEN 0 ELSE 1 END,
            LOWER(twitch_login)
        LIMIT 1
